limits: No external network requests or command execution from examples.
Shell fences are syntax-only bash -n checks, not dependency/build verification.
English and Chinese code blocks need not be byte-identical.
Historical result documents are not recursively audited.

result_retention.policy: Update effective records in place; do not relabel measurements from another source.
result_retention.recovery: Move each listed destination back to its original path when that path is absent.

scientific_baseline.identity_boundary: The 41-gate scientific profile retains its original executed source. Current regression, smoke and strict-restart runs are identified separately.

record_update.previous_identity_boundary: Previous focused 6-plus-282 and maintenance measurements remain in the recoverable local backup, not current test claims.

publication_action: Local record refresh only; no Git commit/push, external publication or third-party contact performed.
